name: Holzalm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Holzalm in Brixlegg**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, the **Holzalm** in **Brixlegg** offers a cozy retreat surrounded by breathtaking mountain scenery. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming alpine hut invites you to unwind and reconnect with nature.

Enjoy traditional **Tiroler hospitality** with hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain cheese. Warm up by the crackling fireplace or take a leisurely stroll through the lush meadows and forests.

Whether you're seeking relaxation, outdoor adventures, or a taste of authentic **Tiroler** culture, **Holzalm** promises an unforgettable escape. Come experience the magic of the mountains!
